svg.aria-label: The merged graph after filtering on Apple and Google. The Sony points F, H and I are removed with their edges. Brand edges keep Apple (A, B, E) and Google (C, D, G) connected internally, and the direct similarity edges A-C and B-G still connect Apple to Google.
